name: SVC_FIELD_GROUPS
description: Field Groups are used to secure read and update operations on its member fields.

columns.name: FIELD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: FIELD_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Autogenerated unique number with customizable format. This is an alternate key for this table.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The foreign key that references ZCA_OBJECTS (LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE).

columns.name: FIELD_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: The name of the field group associated with business object.

columns.name: ALL_FIELDS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that this field group is composed of all fields of the business object.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the field group is active.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the field group is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: PUBLISHED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the field group is published or not.

columns.name: POST_PUBLISH_CHANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the publishable attributes of the field group were changed after the last publish.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
